analysis: The PR changes only docs/architecture/inference.md: the date bump (line 3) and a new paragraph around line 1293 describing PromptPieceTokenStore.lookup. That paragraph says a request's hits are snapshotted before promotion between two bounded generations, so a rotation mid-lookup cannot turn a later piece into a miss. Token arrays share storage during the snapshot, and existing admission and byte bounds still apply. No code, config, endpoint or trust-boundary change is in this diff. The two supplied units are the unchanged surrounding base text at lines 1612-2427 (MTP, sampling, tool parsing, vision, MiMo). Neither contains the changed lines, so I treated them as context and found no inconsistent security claims. The only relevant threat is T-041 (cross-tenant prefix-cache timing and scope). The doc says the piece-token cache is scoped to the prefix-cache scope. That matches the coordinator-authored account/model cacheSalt design. The snapshot is request-local and adds no new persistence, no at-rest artifact and no new cross-scope sharing. Open questions for the next pass: (1) the implementation of PromptPieceTokenStore is not supplied, so I could not verify that scope-keying is preserved and that no cross-scope hit occurs; (2) the piece-token cache is an in-process hit/miss timing surface, which falls under the accepted SEC-035 oracle class and is not newly expanded by this doc change. No finding qualifies because only documentation changed and the claims are consistent with the threat model.
